title: PALASH NIPUN Bharat-aligned FLN starter curriculum
source_note: This is an app-side alignment layer, not a reproduction of the complete NIPUN Bharat curriculum. It organizes teacher-facing activities around NIPUN Bharat's foundational literacy and numeracy mission.
official_reference: Ministry of Education / Department of School Education & Literacy, NIPUN Bharat Guidelines

competencies.title: Oral language and listening
outcomes: Listen and respond to familiar words, stories and classroom instructions.

competencies.title: Early print awareness
outcomes: Recognize familiar symbols, pictures, letters and print in meaningful contexts.

competencies.title: Number sense
outcomes: Count, compare and represent small quantities using concrete objects.

competencies.title: Shapes and patterns
outcomes: Recognize common shapes and continue simple patterns.

competencies.title: Oral language comprehension
outcomes: Listen to short classroom texts and respond to questions using familiar language.

competencies.title: Phonological awareness
outcomes: Notice and work with sounds, syllables and familiar words.

competencies.title: Decoding and early reading
outcomes: Connect letters and sounds and read familiar words and simple sentences.

competencies.title: Number identification and comparison
outcomes: Identify, count and compare numbers using objects and representations.

competencies.title: Early operations
outcomes: Solve simple addition and subtraction situations with concrete materials.

competencies.title: Reading fluency
outcomes: Read familiar age-appropriate text with increasing accuracy and fluency.

competencies.title: Reading comprehension
outcomes: Answer literal questions and retell key information from short texts.

competencies.title: Writing
outcomes: Write simple words and sentences to communicate familiar ideas.

competencies.title: Number operations
outcomes: Use addition and subtraction strategies in familiar situations.

competencies.title: Measurement and patterns
outcomes: Compare measurable attributes and identify or extend simple patterns.

competencies.title: Oral reading fluency
outcomes: Read grade-appropriate text with sufficient accuracy, pace and expression for meaning.

competencies.title: Comprehension
outcomes: Locate, explain and infer information from short texts.

competencies.title: Writing for communication
outcomes: Write connected sentences about familiar experiences and topics.

competencies.title: Number operations
outcomes: Use addition, subtraction, multiplication and division in appropriate contexts.

competencies.title: Fractions, measurement and data
outcomes: Work with simple fractions, measurement, patterns and basic data representations.

activity_templates.story: Tell a short locally relevant story in Hindi, then present key words and a comprehension question in Santali.
activity_templates.picture_talk: Show or draw a familiar local object and ask learners to name, describe and classify it in their familiar language.
activity_templates.counting: Use locally available objects such as seeds, stones or sticks to count, compare and perform simple operations.
activity_templates.phonics: Say a familiar word, isolate its sound/syllable, then connect it to the written form.
activity_templates.reading: Read a short bilingual passage, pause at key words, and ask a literal or inferential question.
activity_templates.assessment: Give one observable task tied to the selected competency and record whether the learner completed it independently, with support, or not yet.
